data.name: Nirdosh
data.gender_notes: Nirdosh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nirdosha', meaning 'free from faults or sins'. This name is often given to a child believed to be pure and free from any blemish or impurity. The name Nirdosh carries the meaning “Innocent, guiltless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nirdosh usually hope their child will grow to embody innocent, guiltless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nirdosh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Innocent, guiltless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nirdosh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

This name is believed to carry blessings and good fortune, and may bring a sense of pride to the family.
